CustomField.description: Current published version of the guardian attestation shown when an adult creates a parent-managed profile. Stamped onto Support_Relationship__c.Guardian_Attestation_Version__c so the record shows which wording the guardian actually agreed to, not merely that they agreed to something.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Bump whenever the guardian attestation wording changes. Existing relationships keep the version they were created under.
CustomField.label: Guardian Attestation Version
